---
title: Page Not Found
# `description-meta` rather than `description:`, matching index.qmd and
# cv/index.qmd: both emit <meta name="description">, but `description:` also
# prints the text as a subtitle beneath the page title, which would leave this
# page saying the same thing twice — once in the subtitle, once in the body.
#
# Needed at all because <meta name="description"> does NOT fall back to
# `website.description` in _quarto.yml the way og:description and
# twitter:description do; omit it and the page ships with no description tag,
# which is what an SEO audit reports against this page.
#
# Worth setting even though the page is noindex, below: auditors fetch
# /404.html directly, and GitHub Pages serves the file itself as 200 — the 404
# status applies only when it stands in for a missing URL — so the warning
# recurs on every crawl until the tag exists.
description-meta: "This page could not be found. Search the site, or return to the homepage for research on lettuce disease resistance."
# GitHub Pages serves this file with a 404 status, so search engines mostly get
# the message from the status code. The meta tag covers the case where they do
# not — a 404 page that gets indexed shows up as a real result for the site and
# leads every visitor who clicks it to a dead end.
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - _includes/noindex.html
---

The page you requested cannot be found (perhaps it was moved or renamed).

You may want to try searching to find the page's new location.
